buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

3. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) 1.Domain Specific STC of Particular Service including its SLA (Service Level Agreement) a) Joint Venture or Subcontract shall not be allowed. b) The Bidder shall not transfer the Contract to any sub agency. c) The Selected Bidder must submit all documentary evidence to 06 th Bn NDRF, Vadodara Gujarat. d) Decision of the Authority/Management regarding the technical qualification is final and binding to the bid der and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard thereafter. e) Buyer also reserves the right to accept/reject any bid including the lowest bid received through e-bid an d/or annul the e-bidding process. (Provisions of GFR, Financial Rules – 2017). f) Buyer reserves the right to reject any Application and/or entire Bidding. g) Process and/or reject all Applications/Bids, at any time without assigning any reasons. h) The whole process of the Bid can be Cancelled/Modified/Redefined/Altered by the 06th Bn NDRF, Vadoda ra Gujarat without giving any prior notice or information. i) The Service Provider shall provide all necessary manpower, equipment, consumables and technical supp ort at its own cost and shall ensure that all arrangements and structures are safe, functional and of good q uality. j) The bidder shall quote a firm and all-inclusive rate, inclusive of GST, transportation, loading/unloading, m anpower, installation, dismantling, logistics and other expenses. No escalation in the accepted contract pri ce shall be permitted. k) No advance payment shall be admissible for this work and 100% payment shall be made only after succ essful completion of the programme, satisfactory meeting of the requirements of the Buyer and submissio n of the prescribed invoice and supporting documents as per GeM/Government procedures. l) Delivery/Service Location: 06th Bn NDRF, Vadodara, Gujarat. m) Penalty, in occurrence of failure on above deadlines or scope of service, will be imposed at 5% per wee k for maximum 1 week before cancellation of the order. n) The service provider must mention the Escalation procedure matrix for customer complaints. o) The selected Service Provider shall nominate an Event Manager/Nodal Officer and provide adequate tec hnical and operational manpower throughout the installation, rehearsal, programme and dismantling perio d. p) The Service Provider shall comply with all applicable safety, electrical, fire, food hygiene, housekeeping and security requirements and shall strictly follow the security instructions of 06th Bn NDRF. q) In case of defective equipment, inadequate service, delay or non-compliance with the approved specific ations/SLA, the Service Provider shall rectify the deficiency immediately. Applicable penalty/liquidated dam ages may be imposed as per the contract and prevailing GeM/Government provisions. r) Date of Event – Month of January 2027 (subject to change; will be informed 07 days prior to event, in cas e of change of dates). 2. Financial and Security Requirements a) PBG: Not Applicable. b) EMD: 3% of the estimated Bid Amount – Compulsory. i. EMD shall be submitted in the form of Demand Draft (D.D.) or in the form of an unconditional Bank Gu arantee (B.G.) (which should be valid till the ending of the programme or 6 months) of any Nationalized Ba nk including Public Sector Bank or Private Sector Banks or Banks as applicable vide Government

Resolutions/instructions issued by the Finance Department from time to time. The D.D./B.G. should be in t he name of “Commandant, 06th Bn. NDRF.” ii. Unsuccessful/disqualified Bidder’s EMD will be returned without any interest as promptly as possible, b ut not later than 15 days after the expiry of the period of Bid validity OR upon the successful Bidder signing the Contract. iii. EMD of successful Bidder will be returned, without any interest, upon the Bidder signing the Contract. c) The procurement shall be processed through Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and shall be governed b y applicable provisions of GFR, 2017, GeM terms and conditions and other Government of India instruction s in force. d) The earlier provision for pro-rata payment based on commencement/progress of work is not recommend ed and should be deleted. Payment should be linked to successful completion and acceptance of the entir e programme. 3. Vendor Eligibility Criteria 3.1 Registered & Qualified Vendors (Documents required) i) The bidder must be registered on GeM with a valid business profile, including: • GST Registration (GSTIN) • PAN (Permanent Account Number) • Valid Business License ii) The company should be operational for at least three (03) years in the required industry. iii) The bidder must not be blacklisted or debarred by any State or Central Government Agency. 3.2 Past Experience (Document required) i) The bidder should have experience of managing at least ONE programme/conference/scientific seminar/ symposium consisting of 1000 or more international/national delegates in Govt. Sector/Semi Govt./PSU Sec tor/Corporate Sector. ii) Acceptable Proof of Past Work (Any One or More): a) Work Orders issued by State/Central Government Departments, Government Institutions/CRACs/SDAC s, organizing committee of VVIP programme, PSUs, or previous orders. b) Completion Certificates from past projects. c) Performance Certificates mentioning the nature of work and portfolio. 3.3 Registered Office or Service Centre Bidder must have a Registered Office or Service Centre or Franchise in Gujarat. Bidder must provide legal proof of Registration Certificate/Agreement between both parties for the same. Full contact details of the o ffice must be provided for cross-verification as per VVIP protocol. 3.4 Compliance Requirements i) Tax Compliance: Up-to-date GST Returns and Income Tax Clearance. ii) Non-Blacklisting Declaration: Self-certified statement confirming no history of debarment. iii) DPIIT Compliance (If Applicable): Bidders from countries sharing a land border with India must be regist ered with DPIIT. 4. Service Preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Service preference will be given to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) from the State of Bid Inviting Autho rity. If the bidder wants to avail the service preference, the bidder must be the Service Provider of the offer ed Event in case of bid for supply of Service. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of Services, the bidder must be the Service Provider of th

e offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in re spect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller(s) has/have quoted a price within L-1 + 20% of the margin defined in th e relevant policy, such Seller shall be given an opportunity to match the L-1 price and the contract will be awarded for 100% of the total quantity, as defined/decided in the policy. 5. Submission Process and Bid Compliance 5.1 Required Documents to be submitted Bidders must submit the following documents on the GeM Portal: i. PAN Card ii. GST Registration Copy iii. Work Order Copies/Past Experience Proof iv. No-Blacklisting Declaration v. Proof of Registered Office/Service Centre in the State vi. Portfolio/Sample Work vii. Agreement to all the STCs/SLAs viii. Bid security declaration ix. Bidder financial standing x. Right to rejection certificate xi. Sharing land border with India Certificate xii. Undertaking for Bid terms & Conditions 5.2. Payment Format and Payment Terms i. The payment will be released after satisfactory completion of the event. ii. Prices should be inclusive of GST. iii. Payment will be processed as per Government Procurement Rules on GeM. 5.3. Evaluation Criteria Bids will be evaluated based on: i. Compliance with eligibility criteria. ii. Adherence to technical specifications. iii. Competitive pricing and timely content delivery and posting commitment. iv. Acceptance of terms and conditions. 4.
